scripts/check-comment-lang.cjs.name: ok
scripts/check-comment-lang.cjs.description: CLANG-01…03 — no new FRENCH code comment in the public corpus, stop-word detection (>= 2 distinct per comment), string literals excluded by a state lexer, per-file frozen count, shrink-only
scripts/check-comment-lang.cjs.rationale: Includes the re-count its task demanded: 794 carrier files / 11 671 French comments measured by a LANGUAGE detector, against a floor of 756 files from the accent motif — which missed accentless French and bit accented English. The first lexer stripped string literals by regex BEFORE scanning: a French apostrophe inside a comment opened phantom literals, and the gate's own ratchet caught its own instrument (+57 ghosts for a two-line edit) — replaced by a single-pass state lexer. Markdown out of scope (the convention wants docs in French). Seen red both ways; the translation of the deposit follows as its own campaign — a translation is read, never substituted.

scripts/check-workshop-paths.cjs.name: ok
scripts/check-workshop-paths.cjs.description: WPATH-00…03 — no PUBLIC PROSE document names a workshop path (`CLAUDE.md`, the harness directory, the copilot file). Complements WREF, which covers the workshop docs directory over a wider corpus including code; this gate takes the harness apparatus on hand-written `.md` only, where a citation is a dead pointer for the public reader rather than an operational mention. Hard failure, no baseline: the corpus was measured at zero carriers at posing, so freezing machinery would only give new debt a place to hide. Tokens are derived from the partition, never restated. One named exemption, witness-checked. All four rules seen red by mutation and restored.
scripts/check-workshop-paths.cjs.rationale: Posed BEFORE the triage — the deliberate inversion of the migrate-first doctrine, motivated by volume: 2725 tokens over 811 public files frozen at posing. The public/workshop boundary is DERIVED from lib/public-partition.cjs, never a hand-written glob. Seen red both ways (new token named with file and count; inflated freeze), byte-checked restores. The triage of the frozen deposit follows as its own campaign — three buckets, three gestures, never a sed.
